commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Jota Silva (Nottingham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) will deliver the corner kick.
90+1' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Nottingham have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
89' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
89' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
87' Neco Williams (Nottingham) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) for Ryan Yates.
84' It is time for a substitution. Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is on for Michael Kayode.
84' Substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard makes way for Yunus Emre Konak (Brentford).
81' The Nottingham players are exchanging some short passes.
81' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
80' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
78' The free kick from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
77' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) jumps into a tackle and Darren England signals a foul. Nottingham will take a free kick near the side line.
76' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken makes a comfortable save.
76' The attendance is 29040.
75' Here is a change. Ola Aina is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham).
75' Substitution. Morgan Gibbs-White did his best and is replaced by Jota Silva (Nottingham).
70' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Mark Flekken tees up Yoane Wissa (Brentford) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Matz Sels.
70' Ola Aina (Nottingham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
68' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
68' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Chris Wood, who fails to shoot.
67' Substitution. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) on for Kevin Schade.
67' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
66' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
65' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
63' The expression of the referee Darren England is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Neco Williams (Nottingham) is shown a yellow card.
63' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
62' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
62' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elliot Anderson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
60' A corner kick by Brentford is thwarted by the well prepared Matz Sels (Nottingham).
60' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) and Chris Wood attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
57' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
57' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
54' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
53' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.

53' Nice individual effort by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Matz Sels does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
52' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
50' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
46' Half-time substitution. Thomas Frank decided to make a change. Keane Lewis-Potter is replaced by Rico Henry (Brentford).
46' Nuno Espirito Santo makes a half-time substitution. Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) comes on in place of Callum Hudson-Odoi.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

44' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Kevin Schade (Brentford) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Nathan Michael Collins. The score is now 0:1.
43' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christian Norgaard (Brentford) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
41' Brentford are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
39' The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
36' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The ball is behind the touchline and Nottingham will take a throw-in.

32' A cross by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
31' The resulting corner, taken by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), comes to nothing.
29' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' The foul by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
25' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
25' The ball is cleared after Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
24' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
23' Nottingham will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
23' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' Good clearance! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
18' Darren England shows a yellow card to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
17' It seemed like Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
16' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Matz Sels into a superb diving save to keep it out.
15' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nottingham was in an offside position.
12' Nottingham are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
12' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
10' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) has tested the patience of referee Darren England and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
9' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
7' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Michael Kayode. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
5' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
3' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort.
3' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
3' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
2' Ola Aina (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
